name.ja: エクスプローリングラボネイチャー ホホジロザメ
name.en: Exploring Lab Nature Great White Shark

description.ja: 「エクスプローリングラボネイチャー」第２弾はホホジロザメ！内部骨格や開口アクションを再現した造型で立体化！
description.en: The second part of "Exploring Lab Nature" is a great white shark! Three-dimensional with a mold that reproduces the internal skeleton and opening action!

description.ja: ■スイッチを押し込むことで頭部骨格を含むリンク機構が作動。本物をイメージした骨格の動きで開口アクションが楽しめる。
description.en: • Pushing the switch activates the link mechanism including the head skeleton. You can enjoy the opening action with the movement of the skeleton inspired by the real thing.

description.ja: ■常に歯が生え変わり続けるサメの特徴を示す予備の歯など「デンタルバッテリー」構造を再現！
description.en: • Reproduce the "dental battery" structure, including spare teeth, which shows the characteristics of sharks that constantly grow new teeth!

description.ja: ■TPE素材で再現された弾力のある口内は上あごのシワまで表現。
description.en: • The elastic inside of the mouth is reproduced using TPE material, and even the wrinkles on the upper jaw are expressed.

description.ja: ■虚ろな瞳は艶ありブラックを採用。鼻先のロレンチーニ器官や鼻の穴まで、頭部をフィーチャーした緻密な造形。
description.en: • The hollow eyes are glossy black. The head is precisely sculpted, including the Lorenzini organ at the tip of the nose and the nostrils.

description.ja: ■水面をイメージした水しぶきはクリアパーツで構成。
description.en: • Splashes inspired by the water surface are made of clear parts.

description.ja: ■頭部に特化することで細部表現までこだわりを詰め込んでいる。
description.en: • By specializing in the head, we pay attention to every detail.
